title: Bring ChatGPT, Gemini, and more into one lifetime workspace for just $79
content_html:
TL;DR: Pay $79 once for lifetime ChatPlayground AI Unlimited access, with 20+ models, side-by-side comparisons, file chat, and unlimited monthly messages.

Credit: ChatPlayground AI

$79
$619 Save $540

Asking three AI tools the same question shouldn’t require three tabs and a copy-and-paste routine. ChatPlayground AI’s Unlimited Plan puts multiple models in one desktop workspace, with a lifetime subscription available for $79 (reg. $619) through Nov. 8. Pay once, then compare responses without the tab-hopping.

The main attraction is side-by-side comparison. Enter a single prompt and view answers from different models, including options such as ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, and DeepSeek. With more than 20 models available, you can compare approaches instead of settling on whichever answer arrived first.

That’s useful when you’re exploring a coding problem, refining a prompt, or looking for a different creative direction. One response might offer a clearer explanation; another might suggest an approach worth investigating. Seeing them together makes those differences easier to assess.

The best tech deal this week

The Apple iPhone 18 Pro is free right now with T-Mobile

ChatPlayground also lets you upload PDFs and images to ask questions about your files, generate AI images, and save chat history for ongoing projects. Prompt-engineering tools help you refine your requests, while priority customer support provides faster assistance when you need it.

The Unlimited Plan includes unlimited monthly messages, subject to a fair use policy, plus priority access to new features and future models. Updates are included, and desktop access supports unlimited devices.

ChatPlayground is also an independent platform, rather than an OpenAI product. Both new and existing users can purchase this offer, and the code must be redeemed within 30 days of purchase.

Mashable Deals

By signing up, you agree to receive recurring automated SMS marketing messages from Mashable Deals at the number provided. Msg and data rates may apply. Up to 2 messages/day. Reply STOP to opt out, HELP for help. Consent is not a condition of purchase. See our Privacy Policy and Terms of Use.

Get ChatPlayground AI’s Unlimited Plan lifetime subscription for $79 (reg. $619) through Nov. 8.

StackSocial prices subject to change.
